title: 3권 2유닛 스토리북 · 1쪽
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Full-page picture-book illustration. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Pim & Pam. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Lunch time in a sunny clearing. A little striped chipmunk runs off with the friends' red lunch box from a green bench toward a round door in a hollow log, which has the two letters c and h carved on it — the ONLY text allowed in the picture; the door snaps shut behind its tail. Bun reaches out in shock; Pip says the two letters apart; Pim and Pam sit on the bench back. Hidden in the picture: the bench, a chess board on a stump, a small axe in a chopped log. Grumble does NOT appear. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Pim & Pam is two tiny twin bluebirds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft, round sky-blue bodies with white bellies, big shiny black eyes, tiny orange beaks, their inner wingtips touching, drawn together as one pair, no letters anywhere.
